output_text: Always structure your Ansible content into roles and collections. Each role/module: one well-defined task. Dedicated `_info`/`_facts` modules/tasks gather information. Enforce strict YAML formatting. File Start: All YAML files must begin with `---`. Indentation: Use two spaces for indentation, never tabs. Quote strings only when necessary; prefer single quotes; use double quotes for escaping or multi-line strings. Us
